jobs.description:
Are you passionate about Linux and business-critical application operations? If so, you have the opportunity to play a key role in operating some of Denmark’s most business- and society-critical solutions. We are looking for an Operations Engineer to join Netcompany Operations, with solid Linux expertise.

Responsibilities and technologies

Netcompany Operations is a well-established operations organization responsible for everything from business- and mission-critical application operations to infrastructure management across two modern data centers and public cloud environments.

Our customer portfolio is highly diverse, ranging from small private companies to large-scale public sector projects. We approach operations with a clear vision: to make a meaningful difference to our customers’ businesses, and we expect you to share that ambition.

You will become part of a team focused on the optimization and operation of large, complex Enterprise Linux environments. From day one, you will be given significant responsibility and influence, playing a central role in designing, implementing, and optimizing both current and future solutions while maintaining direct contact with our customers.

As an experienced Operations Engineer, your responsibilites will typically include:

• Building and maintaining Linux-based environments and applications.

• Ensuring quality, optimization, and automation across environments and applications.

• Participating in ongoing operations projects, including major implementation and transition initiatives.

• Prioritizing and following up on customer requests within your area of responsibility.

About you

You are structured, detail-oriented, and highly accountable. You take full ownership of your work, have a strong service mindset, and understand the importance of supporting business objectives in a positive and constructive manner. In short, you are motivated by making a real impact.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to:

• Hold a degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field (bachelor’s, master’s, or equivalent).

• Have several years of experience from a a similar role.

• Are motivated by delivering optimal business- and mission-critical solutions.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

We encourage you to apply even if your educational background differs from the above, provided you have relevant qualifications and/or professional experience from a similar position.

Employment is contingent upon your ability to obtain and maintain security clearance from the Danish Security and Intelligence Service (PET).

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Do you want to help develop some of Denmark’s most complex and business-critical IT solutions, where software development, project management, and close client collaboration are central parts of everyday work?

Responsibilities and technologies

As an IT Consultant, you help translate client needs into the right technical solution. We choose the technologies that best fit each project and client. As a result, you should enjoy working across a variety of technologies and domains, while continuously expanding your knowledge and expertise.

A large part of our projects is based on web technologies such as Angular or React, and Java or C# on either a Java or .NET platform. In addition, we work with a wide range of standard platforms including Microsoft, Salesforce, IBM, Oracle, Adobe, Snowflake, Guidewire, and others.

As an IT Consultant, you contribute to all parts of system development with a focus on technical tasks. Your tasks will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your responsibilites will typically include:

• Setting up and developing frameworks and integrations.

• Implementing features in user interfaces.

• Configuring and developing extensions for standard platforms.

• Automating business processes, for example through batch jobs.

• Developing tools and scripts for migrating large volumes of data.

You will join a team with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise. What we all have in common is a technical mindset and shared ambition to build the best possible IT solutions together.

Our projects include some of Denmark’s most innovative and mission-critical IT initiatives across the public and private sectors, meaning you will help shape and improve everyday life for a large part of society.

About you

We expect you to hold a masters's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are a recent graduate or have a couple of years of experience – most importantly, you are passionate about taking your IT career to the next level.

• Possess strong technical skills in object-oriented programming.

• Have a solid understanding of software development and are motivated to further develop your skills.

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer for The Tech Collective
jobs.description:
Job Description

We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

What you'll do

This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

In this role, you'll:

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

Beyond that, you'll bring:

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

What we offer

You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

The Role

Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

We are introducing customer marketing as a dedicated discipline at Planday, and this is the role that will build it.

This is a builder's role: you will define how we market to our existing customers, establishing the strategy, the programmes, and the ways of working from the ground up. Across the UK, Nordics, and Germany, you will design and deliver 1:many marketing that drives adoption, deepens engagement, and turns customers into long-term advocates and expansion opportunities.

You will sit at the heart of our commercial ambition: as we target growth in the UK, defend our leadership in the Nordics, and build momentum in Germany, customer marketing is one of the key levers that connects product value to commercial outcomes. This is a role for someone who is energised by creating from scratch, earns trust through execution, and knows that the best customer marketing is grounded in deep empathy for the people you are marketing to.

What You'll Do

Establish the Discipline

• 
Define the customer marketing strategy - audit the current state of customer engagement across all three markets, identify gaps, and build a clear plan for how customer marketing will drive retention, adoption, and expansion at Planday

• 
Set the operating model - establish the ways of working, tools, segmentation logic, and measurement framework that will underpin everything the function delivers

• 
Act as the internal champion for customer marketing - educating and aligning stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales on the role and value of the discipline

Lifecycle & Engagement Programmes

• 
Build always-on 1:many customer engagement across the customer journey through marketing owned channels (e.g. email, in-product, socials, website)

• 
Develop localised programmes for UK, Nordics (Denmark, Norway, Sweden), and Germany - adapting content, tone, and sequencing to reflect the dynamics and customer expectations of each market

Adoption & Expansion

• 
Lead feature adoption campaigns - work closely with Product Marketing to identify the product features most strongly correlated with retention and satisfaction, and creating targeted campaigns that help customers get more from the platform

• 
Own upsell and expansion marketing - delivering behaviour-triggered campaigns that move customers up the tiers, support seat growth, and help customers discover the full value of Planday's offering

• 
Partner with Product Marketing on subscription plan communications and pricing changes, ensuring every customer-facing message reinforces product value and supports commercial goals

Advocacy & Community

• 
Build Planday's customer advocacy programme - identifying and activating champions within the customer base to generate case studies, reviews, testimonials, and referrals

• 
Support reference and social proof pipelines across markets - working with Sales, CS, Brand and Regional marketing to ensure high-quality customer stories are available for every stage of the buyer journey

• 
Explore community-building opportunities - partner with Regional Marketing to execute local community building opportunities such as webinars, customer events, and user groups, that deepen belonging and peer connection among Planday customers

Performance & Insight

• 
Define and own customer marketing metrics - including engagement rates, adoption scores, NRR contribution, upsell pipeline generated, and advocacy outputs and report regularly against them

• 
Use customer health data and behavioural signals to identify at-risk segments and inform targeted retention interventions

• 
Feed customer insight back into the wider marketing and product teams - ensuring the voice of the existing customer shapes how Planday communicates, evolves, and grows

What You'll Bring

Experience & Skills

• 
4–6 years in B2B marketing, with clear experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or retention-focused roles, ideally within a SaaS or technology business

• 
A track record of building programmes from scratch. You have experience establishing a new discipline, process, or team, not just inheriting and maintaining an existing one

• 
Multi-market experience, you are comfortable adapting strategy and execution for audiences across different regions, with an understanding of how culture and market maturity shape customer expectations

• 
Strong lifecycle marketing execution - you know how to design and deliver segmented, behaviour-triggered campaigns across email and in-product channels, and you understand the tools that power them

• 
Data-led - you use customer health scores, product usage data, and campaign performance metrics to make decisions, not just to report on them

• 
Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales, you understand the role each function plays in the customer journey and know how to align activity across them

• 
Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, SFMC, HubSpot) and an appetite to make better use of the data and tooling available

How You Show Up

• 
Customer-focused; you start with what the customer needs, not what the business wants to tell them

• 
A builder by nature; you are energised by the blank page, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating something that didn't exist before

• 
Commercially grounded; you understand how customer marketing connects to revenue and are comfortable being held to NRR and expansion metrics

• 
A natural collaborator; you build trust across functions without needing a mandate, and you bring people with you rather than working around them

• 
Clear and direct communicator; both written and verbal; you can simplify the complex, adapt your message to your audience, and get the room aligned

• 
AI-curious; you actively explore how AI can improve how you work, from personalisation and segmentation to content creation and performance analysis

Why Planday

• 
A genuinely greenfield opportunity, you will define what customer marketing looks like at Planday and build it your way

• 
Work at the intersection of commercial growth and customer experience, your work will have direct, measurable impact on retention and expansion

• 
A collaborative, ambitious marketing team that values craft, clarity, and getting things done

• 
Flexible location - London or Copenhagen, with a hybrid working model

• 
Competitive salary, benefits, and the opportunity to grow with the business as the function scales

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

jobs.occupation: Vertical Market Development Lead - HVAC/R, Europe
jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

**As Vertical Market Development Lead for HVAC & Refrigeration in Europe, you will play a key role in shaping and accelerating Danfoss' growth within one of our most important market segments.

You will develop and drive the regional vertical strategy, helping customers address challenges related to energy efficiency, sustainability, and system performance. By combining deep market understanding with strong commercial leadership, you will identify growth opportunities, strengthen our market position, and support the successful execution of business priorities across Europe.

You'll join a global team driving growth and market development within HVAC & Refrigeration. Working closely with colleagues, customers, and stakeholders across regions, you'll help shape strategic initiatives and accelerate business growth. The role can be based at any Danfoss Drives location in Europe and requires travel of up to 50% of the time.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead the development and execution of the HVAC & Refrigeration vertical strategy across Europe to drive growth, market penetration, and customer engagement.

• Develop regional go-to-market approaches by leveraging customer insights, market trends, regulatory developments, and competitive intelligence.

• Identify and assess market opportunities, support business case development, and provide recommendations on growth priorities and investment decisions.

• Build and strengthen relationships with key customers, system integrators, partners, and industry stakeholders to expand Danfoss' presence and create new business opportunities.

• Enable commercial success by providing market intelligence, sales guidance, training, and strategic support while helping secure a strong pipeline, portfolio mix, and pricing position.

As a recognized vertical expert, you will promote best practice sharing across the organization, identify emerging market trends, and drive collaboration across global and regional teams to maximize customer value and business impact.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in business development, sales, marketing, or vertical development within Drives (VFDs), HVAC, Refrigeration, or a related industry.

• Strong understanding of HVAC & Refrigeration markets, customers, applications, and value chains.

• Proven ability to develop and execute growth strategies, go-to-market plans, and commercial initiatives.

• Skilled at leading through influence, building alignment across a matrix organization, and engaging stakeholders with credibility.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related field; experience with drives, automation, or energy-efficient technologies is an advantage.

You are a strategic and customer-focused professional who enjoys turning market insights into action, building strong partnerships, and driving growth across a complex international organization.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

This role offers the opportunity to shape Danfoss' growth agenda within HVAC & Refrigeration, influence strategic decisions at both regional and global levels, and collaborate with industry-leading customers and partners across Europe.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**At Danfoss, we believe that diverse perspectives foster innovation and help us create better solutions for our customers and communities.

If you're excited about driving growth, shaping market strategy, and influencing the future of HVAC & Refrigeration across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Even if your experience doesn't match every preferred qualification, we encourage you to apply and show us how your skills, experience, and perspective can contribute to our success.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. jobs.occupation: Senior Legal Counsel – Sweden, Denmark & Iceland
jobs.description:
About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Reporting to the Region Counsel, Region North

Position Overview:

Working with the Region Counsel, the role will provide direct country legal support for Scandinavia with a specific focus on Sweden, Denmark and Iceland. The individual will also be part of the management team in Scandinavia and play a leadership role in that forum bringing legal expertise and support on business and culture related matters.

As a strategic business partner, the individual will focus on continuously building an effective legal support function addressing the most pressing legal and external environment challenges and driving/protecting the business in a proactive and creative way.

Highlighted Responsibilities:

• 
Provision of legal advice and support focused on business-oriented solutions on a wide range of matters to colleagues in Scandinavia with a specific focus on Sweden, Denmark and Iceland. Such matters include legal market access issues, medicines tendering, competition law (e.g., supply/distribution related issues), procurement law, pharmaceutical law/advertising, commercial law and general risk management (e.g., ABAC).

• 
The role will require the negotiation and preparation of an extensive range of agreements and, in some cases, negotiations with payors. The individual will need to resolve legal issues using negotiation skills and legal expertise.

• 
Monitor and proactively address with cross functional partners including GM, Government Affairs and Market Access changes in laws and the external environment that affect the business. For example, the dynamic in Denmark created by the US Most Favored Nation pricing policy (MFN). This part of the role will include driving AbbVie’s objectives at the Legal Committee of the LIF in Sweden and support creation of a legal committee in LIF Denmark.

• 
Devise legal strategy and support in cross functional meetings including MLOR meetings (Medical/Legal/OEC/Regulatory).

• 
Provide training on new developments and key legal topics of importance. Develop practical checklists and working tools for the business to facilitate their work.

• 
Represent AbbVie externally to customers, suppliers, wholesalers, competitors, government agencies.

• 
To the extent that complex problems or specific technical expertise is required, select and direct the work of outside counsel.

• 
Continuously develop a solid knowledge of AbbVie´s business and organization and knowledge of the broader business impact of decisions made.

• 
Lawyer qualified in Sweden or Denmark.

• 
Law school degree.

• 
At least 6 years of professional legal expertise, preferably in an international environment, ideally at a law firm and/or multi-national company.

• 
Experience in supporting senior business leaders.

• 
Deep understanding of Scandinavia market and culture.

• 
Highly motivated, flexible, independent with capability to manage people and take initiative. Strong integrity, and strong communication skills.

• 
Ability to prioritize and manage workload across the team and with outside counsel where needed.

• 
Solution-oriented, with ability to proactively identify solutions to complex legal and business challenges.

• 
Based in Sweden.

• 
Prepared to travel to Denmark and other RN markets as required.

• 
Fluent in English.

At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we engineer leading energy-efficient solutions that accelerate the green transition and shape a more sustainable tomorrow. As our new Technical Product & Portfolio Manager, you will play a pivotal role at the intersection of business strategy and technology, turning emerging opportunities into high-impact, revenue-generating solutions.

By connecting strategic vision with practical execution, you will drive customer-centric innovation, transforming existing offerings and unlocking new business models across growth domains such as Data Center Cooling, Digital Services, and Connected Infrastructure Solutions.

Working within the Digital Application Solutions team, you will collaborate closely with business leaders, domain experts, R&D, and engineering teams to identify new opportunities, shape portfolio priorities, and bring concepts from exploration through implementation to deliver measurable business impact.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Drive Business-Led Innovation: Identify and assess high-potential business challenges and market opportunities, building business cases and revenue models.

• Shape the Digital Portfolio: Own and refine the Digital Application Solutions portfolio, roadmaps, backlogs, dependencies, and key decisions.

• Modernize & Expand Offerings: Create new digital value propositions from existing Danfoss products and services to reach new markets.

• Act as the Core Connector: Bridge leadership, business stakeholders, R&D, domain experts, and engineering teams to align goals and direction.

• Accelerate Delivery: Drive progress from exploration and validation to implementation, delivering measurable results in weeks to months.

• Frame & Structure Concepts: Turn complex ideas into clear opportunities, hypotheses, trade-offs, and actionable next steps.

• Lead Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with leadership on executive communication, representing the team with confidence and transparency.

**

• Strong Commercial Mindset: Assess market potential, customer value, and ROI while balancing commercial and technical perspectives.

• Product & Portfolio Experience: Experience as a Product Manager, Technical Product Owner, or Portfolio Manager leading digital solutions from discovery to delivery.

• Domain & Digital Familiarity: Experience or strong interest in digital services, IoT, cloud solutions, connected products, and industrial applications.

• Exceptional Structuring Skills: Bring clarity, focus, and direction to complex and ambiguous challenges.

• Proactive Communicator: Excel at stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, and team representation.

• Outcome-Driven Execution: Deliver measurable business results by driving progress, prioritizing effectively, and managing trade-offs.

• Education & Language: Degree in Business, IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar, with fluent professional English.

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

Fostering a culture of continuous learning and outstanding client experience, you inspire and equip retail teams with the skills, knowledge and mindset needed to deliver on both collective and individual performance objectives. Position

**

• Build and monitor personalized Individual Development Plans for each Beauty Consultant, setting SMART objectives and milestones to track progress over time

• Oversee BC uniform and grooming allocation to ensure every BC is impeccably equipped at all times

**

• Measure the efficiency and business impact of every training through a clear set of KPIs and using sell out data

• Develop and upskill promoters and generic staff populations in key strategic airports by designing targeted and time-efficient training programs

**

• At Travel Retail Europe level: support the organization, coordination and animation of the Annual Convention with all Dior Beauty Consultants in collaboration with the Travel Retail Training Department

**REPORTING TO

**

• Area Manager (based in Paris)

Profile

Ideally, you would have 3 years of experience in Retail Training, Coaching and Retail Management

**Create Passionately

Job Description: What if your next data engineering challenge wasn't building one more solution - but shaping how 150 data engineers build theirs? At Tryg, we are bringing our analytical, AI and pricing landscape together around Databricks and building a stronger, shared engineering foundation across Scandinavia.

We are looking for a Principal Data Engineer to define what great Data Engineering looks like across Tryg - and turn those principles into frameworks, tooling and ways of working that engineers use.

You will get a broad technical mandate, significant autonomy and the opportunity to shape how Data Engineering develops across Tryg.

About the role | Shape Data Engineering across Tryg

As Principal Data Engineer, you will lead the development of Data Engineering Excellence across Tryg. Your focus goes beyond solving individual engineering challenges. You will establish the standards, reference solutions and reusable patterns that enable our teams to build reliable, scalable and maintainable data solutions.

Working closely with Platform Engineering, Lead Data Engineers, Data Architects and Principal colleagues across AI and Pricing, you will:

• Define and evolve engineering standards across development, testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, dependency management and the use of GenAI.

• Develop reference implementations and reusable patterns that can be adopted across teams.

• Co-create frameworks, automation and platform capabilities with Platform Engineering.

• Help shape Tryg's core data architecture and engineering principles.

• Drive adoption and raise technical maturity through guidance, coaching and knowledge sharing.

A key part of your role is turning technical direction into real change. Success isn't a standard documented somewhere - it is better engineering practices becoming part of how 150+ data engineers work.

The role is an individual contributor but participates in the Data Enablement leadership team; to ensure long term decisions are anchored with deep engineering knowledge.

About you | A strong engineer who makes other engineers better

You have a strong technical background and have spent a significant part of your career designing and building complex, production-grade data solutions. Over time, your perspective has expanded from solving individual engineering problems to improving how engineering is done across teams.

You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can structure complex problems, bring together different perspectives, evaluate trade-offs and make technical decisions when alignment cannot be reached.

We imagine that you bring:

• Strong Data Engineering and software engineering fundamentals.

• Experience establishing engineering standards, frameworks or reusable patterns.

• The technical depth to make difficult decisions and explain the trade-offs behind them.

• Experience influencing senior engineers and technical leaders across teams.

• Experience driving adoption at scale - not simply defining standards but changing how teams actually work.

• Ability to think in systems – not just for technical challenges, but also how you solve interaction with large communities

Experience with Databricks, modern data platforms and cloud engineering is highly relevant. Experience from a regulated organization is an advantage, but not a requirement.

You don't need to be the deepest specialist in every data discipline. Your focus will be engineering excellence: how we design, develop, test, deploy, operate and continuously improve data solutions on a large scale – both in data volumes and complexity.

About us | Build the foundation while it is still being shaped

Tryg is one of Scandinavia's largest non-life insurance companies, serving more than 5 million customers across Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

You will join Data Enablement and become part of our strategic technical leadership. Strong engineering practices already exist across Tryg - your opportunity is to help turn the best of them into common approaches that can scale across teams.

There is no finished blueprint waiting for you to maintain. Many of the foundational choices are still being made, giving you the opportunity to leave a significant fingerprint on how Data Engineering is done at Tryg for years to come.

Employee benefits | Something to look forward to

At Tryg, we offer attractive conditions and employee benefits, including:

• An attractive pension scheme.

• General bonus programme.

• Health and dental insurance.

• Five weeks of holiday, five additional holiday days and four extra days off.

• Flexible ways of working with trust and responsibility.

You will also become part of a strong professional community with highly skilled colleagues across Tryg.

**Recruitment process | Show us how you think

**As part of the recruitment process, you will work with a case based on an open engineering challenge. We are less interested in one theoretically perfect answer and more interested in how you approach ambiguity, evaluate technical trade-offs and turn technical direction into something that can successfully be adopted at scale.

**We look forward to hearing from you

**Send us your application and CV no later than 28 October 2026. We encourage you not to include a photo in your CV.

We review applications continuously and will close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Andreas Harmuth at andreas.harmuth@tryg.dk

We encourage everyone regardless of gender identity, age, background, disability or origin to apply for the position. We are proud to have high employee satisfaction, strong professionalism and equal opportunities to develop your career in the Tryg Group. Tryg is the largest non-life insurance company in Scandinavia with activities in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. Every day we strive – each in our own way – to create peace of mind and affect the lives of most Scandinavians. Read more at www.tryg.com

Can you turn footage, graphics and ideas into engaging motion content, with a sharp eye for design? Join our creative team and help bring three Nordic retail brands to life.

At Whiteaway Group, we are continuing our growth journey across the Nordics, with Group Marketing playing a pivotal role. We create content and campaigns that bring customers to our online and physical stores while building our three strategic brands: Skousen, Whiteaway and Tretti.

You will join the creative design team in Group Marketing, working closely with fellow creatives, marketing specialists and media specialists to turn campaign objectives into effective visual communication.

The job

Your main focus will be motion design, animation and video editing. You understand how movement, pacing, sound and composition work together to tell a story, capture attention and make a message clear.

You will develop content from scratch and edit, adapt and repurpose existing material across channels and formats. A strong foundation in graphic design will help you create work that feels considered, consistent and true to each brand, both in motion and in still visuals.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

• Create motion graphics and animations that bring campaign concepts, messages and brand identities to life.

• Edit video with a clear sense of narrative, rhythm and continuity, combining footage, graphics, music and sound.

• Develop content for social media, digital advertising, TV and internal communication, adapting the storytelling to each channel.

• Apply a strong eye for typography, layout, colour and composition across motion content and supporting static assets.

• Collaborate with creative, marketing and media colleagues to deliver content that meets campaign objectives and follows brand guidelines.

• Share ideas and feedback, and explore techniques and tools that improve both the work and the way we produce it.

Your profile

• You have around three years of relevant experience in motion design and video editing, with a portfolio that demonstrates your craft and creative thinking.

• You have a background in motion design, animation, graphic design or a related field.

• You are confident in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, and comfortable working with Illustrator and Photoshop.

• You understand animation principles and use timing, easing and transitions purposefully.

• You have a strong sense of visual storytelling and know how editing, pacing and sound shape the viewer’s experience.

• You have a trained graphic eye and can translate a visual identity into motion while keeping the brand recognisable.

• You enjoy creating new work as well as finding effective ways to adapt existing content.

• You work in a structured way, meet deadlines and contribute openly to collaboration and creative feedback.

We offer an amazing workplace, including:

• A dynamic, ambitious organisation.

• An informal environment with short decision-making processes.

• A culture of trust that gives you room to plan your day and balance your life.

• Flexibility in how and when you work, healthcare, a lunch scheme, a gym and an active staff association, to mention just a few.

Start date, application and questions

We review applications and hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your cover letter, CV and portfolio as soon as possible. Include examples of motion design and video editing, and briefly describe your contribution to the work.

If you have questions about the role, please contact Daniel Kjeldsen, Creative Lead & Manager, at dkj@whiteawaygroup.com.

Applications may be submitted in Danish or English and must be sent via the “Apply” button.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Whiteaway Group is an ambitious, successful and fast-growing e-commerce and retail company. We sell white goods and premium home products to customers throughout the Nordics via several online shops and the Skousen franchise.

The idea for Whiteaway Group arose in the backroom of a Danish kitchen store. The foundation was innovation, business acumen and excellent customer experience. And it still is. **Scientist for Laboratory-Scale Preparative HPLC Impurity Isolation

**Join Xellia Pharmaceuticals and help develop life-saving antibiotics.

**We are looking for a Scientist or Senior Scientist to join ourAnalytical Development Laboratory in Copenhagen. In this role, you will lead the isolation, purification, and characterization of impurities from antibiotic production processes, supporting the development and registration of existing and new pharmaceutical products.

You will become part of an international Analytical Development team of 11 skilled colleagues based in Copenhagen and Oslo. The department develops and validates analytical methods and applies techniques such as HPLC/UHPLC, LC-MS/MS, 2D-LC-MS, GC-FID, TGA/DSC, and Preparative HPLC.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Isolate, purify, and characterize fermentation- and degradation-related impurities from APIs and finished products

• Develop and optimize laboratory-scale purification processes using Preparative HPLC

• Investigate impurity formation mechanisms and support problem-solving activities

• Analyze, evaluate, and document results in accordance with GLP/GMP requirements

• Certify impurity Reference Standards according to pharmacopeial guidelines

• Collaborate closely with R&D, Production, QC, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs

• Support inspections, product registrations, and technical investigations

**Your profile

**

• M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field

• Hands-on experience withPreparative HPLC is essential; peptide purification experience is an advantage

• Strong understanding of organic chemistry, molecular interactions, and reaction mechanisms

• Experience with NMR, LC-MS/MS, and structure elucidation is an advantage

• Knowledge of GMP/GLP, method validation, and pharmacopeial requirements is beneficial

• Able to work independently while thriving in a collaborative, cross-functional environment

**What We Offer

**

• A meaningful role contributing to the development of life-saving antibiotics

• An international and collaborative work environment

• Opportunities for professional and personal development

• Collaboration with highly skilled scientists across multiple locations

• Competitive salary, bonus scheme, pension, and health insurance

Ready to shape compliance in a dynamic global company? Join KK Group as our New Legal Compliance Counsel and play a pivotal role in building and advancing our Legal Compliance function.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Legal Compliance Counsel in support of the expanding Legal Compliance function as part of the Legal Governance, Compliance & Projects department. Our new colleague should be a team player who can navigate the complexities of a high-growth environment and contribute to the continued success and sustainability of our organisation and business.

This role will play a big part of the ambitious growth trajectory and foster a culture of compliance awareness across our organisation and in our business activities in general.

As Legal Compliance Counsel you will be supporting the entire organisation, locally and globally. You will be responsible for driving and supporting the expansion of a Legal Compliance function, collaborating with key stakeholders throughout the organisation, and embedding legal compliance practices across all levels of the organisation.

Responsibilities

Compliance:

Develop, implement, and integrate a robust compliance framework tailored to the activities and risk profile of the entire organisation, locally and globally, entailing among others:

• Being on top of regulatory developments related to Legal Compliance, hereunder implementing and driving the organisation’s set-up in relation to NIS2, CRA, Data Act etc.

• Developing and delivering training programs to build and promote legal compliance awareness throughout the organisation.

• Leading the review and implementation of relevant global policies, guidelines and procedures.

• Driving a compliance culture with continuous improvements by assessing and enhancing processes and tools.

• Supporting PMI activities within specified legal compliance disciplines.

• Cooperating with and being the point of contact to external advisors on legal compliance matters.

Governance & Projects:

As a part of the Legal Governance, Compliance & Projects department, you will also take part in tasks related to Governance and Legal Projects in general, supporting the Legal Corporate/Commercial department and the future growth of KK Group.

Our Requirements

• A master’s degree in Law or Business Law, preferably supplemented by at least 4 years of relevant experience from a law ﬁrm or an in-house legal position.

• Strong knowledge of compliance principles and best practices.

• Professional pride and constantly pursuing improvements when providing legal services.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively across diverse teams.

• Ability to work efficiently and independently.

• You are a team player who strives to build and maintain trustful and solid relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

Location:

This position can be based in any KK Group's offices in Denmark, with flexibility for hybrid work.

If you do not meet all the requirements? No worries – If you possess a can-do attitude, enjoy a collaborative environment and embrace a culture of continuous improvement, we would like to hear from you.
